commands:
set -eu
wt=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/macbook-trackpad-zoom
cd "$wt"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 6d08908929d643f10bf58488f8b8382ba325659e
test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1)"
test -x backend/.venv/bin/python
test -x frontend/node_modules/.bin/vite
for port in 8000 5174 18110 15110; do
  if lsof -nP -iTCP:"$port" -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | grep -q LISTEN; then
    echo "PORT_BUSY_ABORT=$port"
    exit 4
  fi
done
printf 'PREPARING_SYNTHETIC_TEST_MAP\n'
PERF_SEED_PLACES=120 PERF_EXPECT_MIN_PLACES=100 ./scripts/quality/perf_smoke.sh
test -f .dev/perf/backend-data/app.db
test -d .dev/perf/storage/public
printf 'COPYING_OWN_ISOLATED_TEST_FIXTURES\n'
SOURCE_DB="$wt/.dev/perf/backend-data/app.db" TARGET_DB="$wt/backend/data/app.db" backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import os, sqlite3
src=sqlite3.connect("file:"+os.environ["SOURCE_DB"]+"?mode=ro",uri=True)
dst=sqlite3.connect(os.environ["TARGET_DB"])
src.backup(dst)
assert dst.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]=="ok"
places=dst.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place WHERE status='published'").fetchone()[0]
photos=dst.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo WHERE status='approved'").fetchone()[0]
print("LOCAL_FIXTURE_PLACE_COUNT",places)
print("LOCAL_FIXTURE_PHOTO_COUNT",photos)
assert places >= 100 and photos >= 100
dst.close()
src.close()
PY
rsync -a .dev/perf/storage/ backend/storage/
printf 'LOCAL_STORAGE_KB=%s\n' "$(du -sk backend/storage | awk '{print $1}')"
printf 'SMOKE_LOCAL_SERVER_DEFAULT_PORTS\n'
cleanup() { ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
make start
curl -fsS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
printf '\nPUBLIC_MAP_RESPONSE_BYTES=%s\n' "$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/places/map | wc -c | tr -d ' ')"
curl -fsS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w 'FRONTEND_HTTP=%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:5174/
cleanup
trap - EXIT
printf 'FINAL_BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git branch --show-current)"
printf 'FINAL_SHA=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'FINAL_DIRTY_COUNT=%s\n' "$(git status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo PHOTOMAP_MAC_ZOOM_SERVER_PREPARED_AND_SMOKED
